yunlv-pod-agent v1.0.2 Changelog

- Clarified skill positioning to focus on POD strategy generation and optimization advice, rather than direct automation or agent execution.
- Updated description, triggers, tags, and tool capabilities to reflect a shift from "自动化操作" to "智能建议" ("from automation to advisory support").
- Adjusted all sample workflows and tool listings to emphasize operation strategies, optimization suggestions, and design planning instead of execution.
- Refined compliance, data privacy, and permission declarations to further stress that the skill does not connect to stores or execute actions directly—users confirm and implement all actions.
- Improved language consistency and terminology for broader clarity and better alignment with strategic consulting use cases.

yunlv-pod-agent 1.0.1

- Enhanced security and privacy section: clarified detailed data flow, storage, and compliance statements.
- Updated API integration details to specify strategy-only communication; removed all references to direct store/platform API operations.
- Expanded and clarified permissions boundary, now explicitly listing prohibited actions regarding sensitive data.
- Added transparency tables outlining what data is handled, how, and with what protections.
- Introduced a new promotional article file.

- Initial release of yunlv-pod-agent, focused on AI-powered automation for Print on Demand (POD) business operations.
- Provides step-by-step guidance on building and optimizing POD workflows with AI Agents, including product design, store management, and customer service.
- Includes tiered tool recommendations and workflow schemes for beginners, advanced users, and large-scale store operations.
- Offers best practices for safe AI-generated design, copyright compliance, and data privacy.
- Integrates references such as tool comparison tables, design formulas, and operational checklists for practical application.
- Supports integration with Yunlv AI TradeGPT API and other user-configured platform APIs.
